notes: MAINT-BRAIN stories defined covering schema, logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for GPTReader + manifest
Added integration with manifest + audit systems

stories.title: Define GPTReader and Manifest Schema Contracts
stories.description: Define and standardize request/response schema for GPTReader including query limits, pagination, and manifest reference contract to ensure consistent usage across Brain components.

stories.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Guardrails
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader with stricter enforcement of 500KB response cap, 100-document limits, retry logic, and failure handling to prevent overload and inconsistent outputs.

stories.title: Expose Manifest-Aware Read Interface
stories.description: Add internal API interface ensuring all GPTReader queries reference manifest entries for traceability and enforce manifest-aligned access patterns.

stories.title: GPTReader Unit and Integration Test Suite Expansion
stories.description: Expand test coverage for GPTReader including edge cases (limit breaches, malformed queries, auth failures) and manifest consistency validation.

stories.title: Audit Logging Consistency for GPTReader Operations
stories.description: Standardize audit logging for all GPTReader operations including query metadata, manifest references, and response size to ensure traceability and compliance with Brain audit patterns.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict limits and expand test coverage without adding new infrastructure.
